name: modReLU_lipschitz_of_nonpos
doc: **主定理：`b ≤ 0` 时 modReLU 是 1-Lipschitz**。证明见模块 docstring 的路线。
stmt:
theorem modReLU_lipschitz_of_nonpos (b : ℝ) (hb : b ≤ 0) (z w : ℂ) :
    Complex.abs (modReLU b z - modReLU b w) ≤ Complex.abs (z - w)
proof:
by
  set c : ℝ := -b with hc
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by rw [hc]; linarith
  have htb : ∀ t : ℂ, Complex.abs t + b = Complex.abs t - c := by
    intro t
    rw [hc]
    ring
                                  
  have hrev : |Complex.abs z - Complex.abs w| ≤ Complex.abs (z - w) := by
    simpa only [← Complex.norm_eq_abs] using abs_norm_sub_norm_le z w
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst hz
    rw [modReLU_zero, zero_sub]
    rw [show Complex.abs (-(modReLU b w)) = Complex.abs (modReLU b w) from
      Complex.abs.map_neg (modReLU b w)]
    rw [show Complex.abs ((0 : ℂ) - w) = Complex.abs w from by
      rw [zero_sub, Complex.abs.map_neg]]
    by_cases hw : w = 0
    · subst hw
      rw [modReLU_zero]
    · rw [modReLU_magnitude b w hw, htb w]
      exact max_le (by linarith [hc0]) (Complex.abs.nonneg w)
  · by_cases hw : w = 0
    · subst hw
      rw [modReLU_zero]
      simp only [sub_zero]
      rw [modReLU_magnitude b z hz, htb z]
      exact max_le (by linarith [hc0]) (Complex.abs.nonneg z)
    ·                 
      have hrz : 0 < Complex.abs z := by
        rw [← Complex.norm_eq_abs]
        exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hz
      have hrw : 0 < Complex.abs w := by
        rw [← Complex.norm_eq_abs]
        exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hw
      rcases le_or_lt (Complex.abs z) c with hzc | hzc
      ·                           
        have hzneg : Complex.abs z - c ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have hrelu : relu (Complex.abs z + b) = 0 := by
          rw [htb z]
          unfold relu

name: rmsNorm_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem rmsNorm_lipschitz {n : ℕ} (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hy : c ≤ ‖y‖) :
    ‖(Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x) - (Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖y‖) • y)‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt n * 2 / c) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
                             
  have hdiff : (Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x) - (Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖y‖) • y)
      = (Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y) := by
    rw [← smul_sub]
  rw [hdiff]
  calc
    ‖(Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y)‖
        = Real.sqrt n * ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg n)]
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt n * ((2 / c) * ‖x - y‖) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (unit_normalize_lipschitz x y c hc hx hy) (Real.sqrt_nonneg n)
    _ = (Real.sqrt n * 2 / c) * ‖x - y‖ := by ring

stmt:
theorem lipschitz_constant_lower_bound {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (f : E → E) (K : ℝ) (a b : E)
    (hK : ‖f a - f b‖ ≤ K * ‖a - b‖) (hd : 0 < ‖a - b‖) :
    ‖f a - f b‖ / ‖a - b‖ ≤ K
proof:
by
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hd]
  exact hK

name: unit_normalize_antipodal_real
doc: 取等点对上单位化映射的距离恰为 2：‖c/|c| − (−c)/|−c|‖ = 2。
stmt:
lemma unit_normalize_antipodal_real (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ‖(1 / ‖(c : ℝ)‖) • (c : ℝ) - (1 / ‖(-c : ℝ)‖) • (-c : ℝ)‖ = 2
proof:
by
  have hc' : ‖(c : ℝ)‖ = c := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc]
  have hnc : ‖(-c : ℝ)‖ = c := by rw [norm_neg, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc]
  have e1 : (1 / c) • (c : ℝ) = 1 := by
    rw [smul_eq_mul, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc)]
  have e2 : (1 / c) • (-c : ℝ) = -1 := by
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_neg, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc)]
  rw [hc', hnc, e1, e2]
  norm_num

name: unit_normalize_sharp
doc: 常数 1/c **可达**（取等）：x = c、y = −c 时两侧同为 2。
stmt:
theorem unit_normalize_sharp (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ‖(1 / ‖(c : ℝ)‖) • (c : ℝ) - (1 / ‖(-c : ℝ)‖) • (-c : ℝ)‖
      = (1 / c) * ‖(c : ℝ) - (-c : ℝ)‖
proof:
by
  rw [unit_normalize_antipodal_real c hc]
  have e3 : (c : ℝ) - (-c) = 2 * c := by ring
  rw [e3, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hc]

name: unit_normalize_constant_lower_bound
doc: 由 x = c、y = −c 的取等点，任何有效常数 K 都满足 K ≥ 1/c。
stmt:
theorem unit_normalize_constant_lower_bound (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (K : ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ x y : ℝ, c ≤ ‖x‖ → c ≤ ‖y‖ →
      ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖) :
    1 / c ≤ K
proof:
by
  have hx : c ≤ ‖(c : ℝ)‖ := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc]
  have hy : c ≤ ‖(-c : ℝ)‖ := by rw [norm_neg, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc]
  have h := hK c (-c) hx hy
  have heq2 : ‖(c : ℝ) - (-c : ℝ)‖ = 2 * c := by
    rw [show (c : ℝ) - (-c) = 2 * c by ring, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
  rw [unit_normalize_antipodal_real c hc, heq2] at h
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hc]
  nlinarith [h]

name: norm_rmsNormE
doc: ‖x‖ = c 时 ‖RMSNorm(x)‖ = √n。
stmt:
lemma norm_rmsNormE {n : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ‖x‖ = c) : ‖rmsNormE x‖ = Real.sqrt n
proof:
by
  have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := by rw [hx]; exact hc
  unfold rmsNormE
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg n)]
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (one_div_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hxpos)), hx, one_div,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc), mul_one]

name: rmsNorm_constant_lower_bound
doc: 取等点对给出 RMSNorm 常数的下界：任何有效 K 满足 K ≥ √n/c。
stmt:
theorem rmsNorm_constant_lower_bound {n : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c K : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ‖x‖ = c)
    (hK : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖rmsNormE x - rmsNormE y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖) :
    Real.sqrt n / c ≤ K
proof:
by
  have h := hK (-x)
  have h2 : ‖x - (-x)‖ = 2 * c := by
    have hsub : x - (-x) = (2 : ℝ) • x := by rw [sub_neg_eq_add, two_smul]
    rw [hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hx]
    norm_num
  rw [rmsNormE_antipodal_norm x c hc hx, h2] at h
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hc]
  nlinarith [h]

name: rmsNorm_two_sqrt_not_attained
doc:
(2√n/c) 界在取等点对上是严格的（n > 0）：2√n < 4√n，
    故 RMSNorm 的 2√n/c 不是紧界（真常数 ≤ √n/c）。
stmt:
theorem rmsNorm_two_sqrt_not_attained {n : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ‖x‖ = c) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ‖rmsNormE x - rmsNormE (-x)‖ < (2 * Real.sqrt n / c) * ‖x - (-x)‖
proof:
by
  have h2 : ‖x - (-x)‖ = 2 * c := by
    have hsub : x - (-x) = (2 : ℝ) • x := by rw [sub_neg_eq_add, two_smul]
    rw [hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hx]
    norm_num
  rw [rmsNormE_antipodal_norm x c hc hx, h2]
  have hval : (2 * Real.sqrt n / c) * (2 * c) = 4 * Real.sqrt n := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hc]; ring
  rw [hval]
  have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt n := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hn)
  linarith

doc: ctr 与 RealNormLipschitz 中的表达形式一致。

name: sum_ctr_eq_zero
doc: 中心化输出的坐标和为零（等价的零均值）。
stmt:
lemma sum_ctr_eq_zero {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, ctr z i = 0
proof:
by
  simp only [ctr]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hn : (n : ℝ) = 0

    subst hn0
    simp

name: inner_ctr_constOne
doc: ctr 与常向量正交（正交投影的刻画）。
stmt:
lemma inner_ctr_constOne {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    inner (ctr z) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = (0 : ℝ)
proof:
by
  have h1 : inner (ctr z) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = ∑ i : Fin n, ctr z i := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
    simp [Matrix.dotProduct, constOne]
  rw [h1, sum_ctr_eq_zero z]

name: ctr_idempotent
doc: ctr 幂等（投影的核心性质）。
stmt:
lemma ctr_idempotent {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ctr (ctr z) = ctr z
proof:
by
  funext i
  show ctr z i - (∑ j : Fin n, ctr z j) / (n : ℝ) = ctr z i
  rw [sum_ctr_eq_zero z, zero_div, sub_zero]

name: ctr_norm_le
doc: ctr 不增范数（正交投影的收缩性）。
stmt: lemma ctr_norm_le {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) : ‖ctr z‖ ≤ ‖z‖
proof:
by
  rw [ctr_eq]
  exact center_norm_le z

name: center_map_is_projection
doc:
**中心化映射是正交投影**：幂等、正交于常向量、零均值超平面上恒等、
    1-Lipschitz 且不增范数。
stmt:
theorem center_map_is_projection (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ctr (ctr z) = ctr z) ∧
    (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      inner (ctr z) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = (0 : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      (∑ i : Fin n, z i) / (n : ℝ) = 0 → ctr z = z) ∧
    (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖ctr z‖ ≤ ‖z‖) ∧
    (∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖ctr x - ctr y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖)
proof:
⟨fun z => ctr_idempotent z,
   fun z => inner_ctr_constOne z,
   fun z h => ctr_fixes z h,
   fun z => ctr_norm_le z,
   fun x y => ctr_lipschitz x y⟩

name: center_lipschitz_sharp
doc:
1-常数是**紧的**：在零均值超平面上 ctr 是恒等，故任意两个超平面向量
    使 ‖ctr x − ctr y‖ = 1·‖x − y‖ 取等。
stmt:
theorem center_lipschitz_sharp {n : ℕ} (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : (∑ i : Fin n, x i) / (n : ℝ) = 0)
    (hy : (∑ i : Fin n, y i) / (n : ℝ) = 0) :
    ‖ctr x - ctr y‖ = 1 * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  rw [ctr_fixes x hx, ctr_fixes y hy, one_mul]

name: center_lipschitz_constant_optimal
doc: 中心化 Lipschitz 常数的下界：超平面上任意两个不同点给出 K ≥ 1。
stmt:
theorem center_lipschitz_constant_optimal {n : ℕ} (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : (∑ i : Fin n, x i) / (n : ℝ) = 0)
    (hy : (∑ i : Fin n, y i) / (n : ℝ) = 0) (K : ℝ)
    (hK : ‖ctr x - ctr y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    1 ≤ K
proof:
by
  have hd : 0 < ‖x - y‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hxy)
  have heq : ‖ctr x - ctr y‖ = ‖x - y‖ := by
    rw [ctr_fixes x hx, ctr_fixes y hy]
  rw [heq] at hK
  have hdiv : ‖x - y‖ / ‖x - y‖ ≤ K := (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr hK
  rwa [div_self (ne_of_gt hd)] at hdiv

end Lattice

name: safe_normalize_radial_bound
stmt:
lemma safe_normalize_radial_bound (ε : ℝ) (x y : E) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    |(‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ - (‖y‖ + ε)⁻¹| ≤ ‖x - y‖ / ε ^ 2
proof:
by
  have ha : 0 < ‖x‖ + ε := safe_normalize_denom_pos ε x hε
  have hb : 0 < ‖y‖ + ε := safe_normalize_denom_pos ε y hε
  have hprod : ε ^ 2 ≤ (‖x‖ + ε) * (‖y‖ + ε) := by
    have hxa : ε ≤ ‖x‖ + ε := safe_normalize_denom_ge ε x
    have hyb : ε ≤ ‖y‖ + ε := safe_normalize_denom_ge ε y
    calc ε ^ 2 = ε * ε := by ring
      _ ≤ (‖x‖ + ε) * (‖y‖ + ε) := mul_le_mul hxa hyb hε.le ha.le
  have hnum : |(‖y‖ + ε) - (‖x‖ + ε)| = |‖y‖ - ‖x‖| := by ring_nf
  have hnorm : |‖y‖ - ‖x‖| ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
    exact abs_norm_sub_norm_le x y
  rw [inv_sub_inv_eq (ne_of_gt ha) (ne_of_gt hb), abs_div, abs_of_pos (mul_pos ha hb), hnum]
  calc |‖y‖ - ‖x‖| / ((‖x‖ + ε) * (‖y‖ + ε))
      ≤ ‖x - y‖ / ((‖x‖ + ε) * (‖y‖ + ε)) := by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnorm (mul_pos ha hb).le
    _ ≤ ‖x - y‖ / ε ^ 2 := by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (norm_nonneg _) (pow_pos hε 2) hprod

name: norm_sq_line_deriv
stmt:
lemma norm_sq_line_deriv (u w : F) :
    deriv (fun t : ℝ => ‖u + t • w‖ ^ 2) 0 = 2 * inner u w
proof:
by

name: avgSmooth_sub_mean
doc:
**去均值后收缩为 0（一次投影）**：`∑_j (h j − mean h) = 0` 时
`avgSmooth (h − mean h) = 0`。

**⚠ `[Nonempty ι]` 是不可省的显式假设**（G3 修正）：`Fintype.card_ne_zero`
的**语句本身**是 `[Nonempty α] → card α ≠ 0`（pinned `Data/Fintype/Card.lean:507`），
即**它要求 `Nonempty` 作为输入**。故
`haveI : Nonempty ι := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero Fintype.card_ne_zero)`
是**循环论证**（要证 `Nonempty ι` 却先用了需要 `Nonempty ι` 的引理）⟹
实测报 `failed to synthesize Nonempty ι`。
⇒ 正确做法：把 `[Nonempty ι]` 提为**定理的显式类型类参数**（STYLE「`haveI` 不能覆盖
定理陈述里的实例需求」），使陈述与证明体同处一个实例作用域。
stmt:
theorem avgSmooth_sub_mean (h : ι → ℝ) [Nonempty ι] :
    avgSmooth (fun j => h j - mean h) = fun _ => 0
proof:
by
  have hN : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hsum : ∑ j, (h j - mean h) = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have hconst : (∑ _j : ι, mean h) = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * mean h := by
      have h1 : (∑ _j : ι, mean h) = (Finset.univ : Finset ι).card • mean h :=
        Finset.sum_const _
      rw [h1, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hmean : mean h = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ j, h j := rfl
    rw [hconst, hmean, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hN, one_mul, sub_self]
  have hval : avgSmooth (fun j => h j - mean h)
      = fun _ => (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ j, (h j - mean h) := by
    unfold avgSmooth
    rfl
  rw [hval, hsum, mul_zero]

name: avgSmooth_deviation_shrink
doc:
**偏差收缩（核心引理）**：在额外假设 `∑_j (h j − c) = 0`（`c` 是**精确均值**）
与 `∀j, |h j − c| ≤ A` 下，对**任意** `i`，

    `|avgSmooth h i − c| ≤ (1/N)·A`（`N = |ι| ≥ 1`）。

**⚠ 常数是 `1/N`，不是 `1 − 1/N`**（旧稿 docstring 曾写 `1 − 1/N`，已校正）。

**为什么 `1 − 1/N` 推不出来（本引理证明的核心论证）**：
`avgSmooth h i − c = (1/N)∑_j (h j − c)`，逐项拆出 `j = i`：

    `(1/N)∑_j (h j − c) = (1/N)(h i − c) + (1/N)∑_{j≠i}(h j − c)`

对第二项用 `|∑_{j≠i}(h j − c)| ≤ (N−1)·A`（每项 ≤ A，共 `N−1` 项），
于是左端 `≤ (1/N)|h i − c| + (1/N)(N−1)A ≤ (1/N)A + (1−1/N)A = A`
——这只给 `A`。为得到**严格**的 `(1−1/N)A`，用更强的观察：
**`(N−1)` 个「其他项」各自都不超过 `A`，但 `(h i − c)` 与它们的和
必须满足「总和 = N·(均值偏差)」**；正确做法是**逐项**用 `|h j − c| ≤ A`
（含 `j = i`，共 `N` 项）得 `|·| ≤ (1/N)·N·A = A`，**仍然只是 `A`**。

因此 `(1−1/N)A` **不能**从 `|h j − c| ≤ A` 单独推出——见 §四
`avgSmooth_deviation_shrink` 的**额外假设** `∑_j (h j − c) = 0`
（即 `c` 是**精确均值**）：此时 `∑_{j≠i}(h j − c) = −(h i − c)`，故

    `|avgSmooth h i − c| = (1/N)|h i − c| ≤ (1/N)·A`。

**本引理实际陈述的形式**（且这才是「收缩」的真正来源）：

    `∑_j (h j − c) = 0` ⟹ `|avgSmooth h i − c| ≤ (1/N)·A`（`∀j, |h j − c| ≤ A`）。

`1/N` 与 `1 − 1/N` 在 `N ≥ 3` 时**不相等**（`N = 2` 时恰好都为 `1/2`）；
本文件**只证了 `1/N`**（且额外需要「`c` 是精确均值」）。误写为 `1 − 1/N`
会让读者以为 `N` 大时收缩更快——**方向恰好相反**（`1/N` 更小 ⟹ 更强）。
stmt:
theorem avgSmooth_deviation_shrink (h : ι → ℝ) (c A : ℝ) [Nonempty ι]
    (hmean : ∑ j, h j - (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * c = 0)
    (hA : ∀ j, |h j - c| ≤ A) (i : ι) :
    |avgSmooth h i - c| ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * A
proof:
by
  have hN : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hdec : avgSmooth h i - c = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ j, (h j - c) := by
    have h1 : avgSmooth h i = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ j, h j := rfl
    have hc : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * c) = c := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hN, one_mul]
    have h3 : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((∑ j, h j) - (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * c)
        = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ j, h j - c := by
      rw [mul_sub, hc]
    have h2 : ∑ j, (h j - c) = (∑ j, h j) - (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * c := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [show (∑ _j : ι, c) = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * c from by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]]
    rw [h1, h2, ← h3]
  have hsum0 : ∑ j, (h j - c) = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [show (∑ _j : ι, c) = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * c from by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]]
    linarith
  rw [hdec, hsum0, mul_zero, abs_zero]
  exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos :
    (0 : ℝ) < (Fintype.card ι : ℝ))))
    (le_trans (abs_nonneg (h i - c)) (hA i))

name: avgSmoothIter_is_const
doc:
**均匀聚合一步归零**：`k ≥ 1` 时 `avgSmoothIter h k i = avgSmoothIter h k j`
（本文件自证的版本，用于 §A 的双向刻画）。
stmt:
theorem avgSmoothIter_is_const (h : ι → ℝ) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ c : ℝ, avgSmoothIter h (k + 1) = fun _ => c
proof:
by
                                                        
                                                            
                                                                
                                                                                         
                                                              
                                                              
                                                                   
                                     
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => exact ⟨mean h, avgSmooth_eq_mean h⟩
  | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ih
                                                                            
                                                               
                                                  
      refine ⟨mean (fun _ : ι => c), ?_⟩
      have hstep : avgSmoothIter h (k + 1 + 1) = avgSmooth (avgSmoothIter h (k + 1)) := rfl
      rw [hstep, hc, avgSmooth_eq_mean]

name: avgSmoothIter_eq
doc: **`k ≥ 1` 时任意两节点相等**：过平滑在**一步内完成**。

theorem avgSmoothIter_eq (h : ι → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (i j : ι) :
    avgSmoothIter h (k + 1) i = avgSmoothIter h (k + 1) j
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := avgSmoothIter_is_const h k

name: mean_bound_pos_of_ne
doc:
**非零归一化条件确实强制 `M > 0`**：只要 `h i ≠ h j` 且 `M ≥ |h i|`、`M ≥ |h j|`，
则 `0 < M`。这是 §A 中「`C ≥ 0` 是必要的」的**唯一**原因。
stmt:
theorem mean_bound_pos_of_ne {h : ι → ℝ} {i j : ι} {M : ℝ} (hne : h i ≠ h j)
    (hi : |h i| ≤ M) (hj : |h j| ≤ M) : 0 < M
proof:
by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (h i) (h j) with hlt | heq | hgt
  · have h1 : -(h i) ≤ |h i| := neg_le_abs (h i)
    have h2 : h j ≤ |h j| := le_abs_self (h j)
    linarith
  · exact absurd heq hne
  · have h1 : -(h j) ≤ |h j| := neg_le_abs (h j)
    have h2 : h i ≤ |h i| := le_abs_self (h i)
    linarith

name: uniformSharp_eq_zero_iff
doc:
**§A 主定理（双向）**：`UniformSharpConst i j C ↔ 0 ≤ C`。

即：**在非退化归一化条件下，均匀聚合的过平滑常数的「最优值」恰为 `0`**。
（⟸ 方向由 `avgSmoothIter_eq` 直接给出——差恒为 `0`；
⟹ 方向：取指示函数 `h = 1_{i}`（`h i = 1`、`h j = 0`）与 `M = 1`，
则左端为 `0`，故 `0 ≤ C·1 = C`。）

**⚠ 与 docstring 同读**：这**不是**「过平滑与常数无关」——
`0` 之所以是下界，是因为差恒为 `0` 且 `M` 被条件强制为正。
stmt:
theorem uniformSharp_eq_zero_iff (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) (C : ℝ) :
    UniformSharpConst i j C ↔ 0 ≤ C
proof:
by
                         
  let h₁ : ι → ℝ := fun k => if k = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0
                                                         
                                                                                
  have h₁i : h₁ i = 1 := by
    simp only [h₁, if_pos rfl]
  have h₁j : h₁ j = 0 := by
    simp only [h₁, if_neg (fun h : j = i => hij h.symm)]
  have h₁abs : ∀ k, |h₁ k| ≤ 1 := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : k = i
    · have hk' : h₁ k = 1 := by
        simp only [h₁, if_pos hk]
      rw [hk', abs_one]
    · have hk' : h₁ k = 0 := by
        simp only [h₁, if_neg hk]
      rw [hk', abs_zero]
      norm_num
  constructor
  · intro hC
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    have hne : h₁ i ≠ h₁ j := by
      rw [h₁i, h₁j]
      norm_num
    have h := hC h₁ hne 1 h₁abs
    have hzero : avgSmoothIter h₁ 1 i - avgSmoothIter h₁ 1 j = 0 :=
      sub_eq_zero.mpr (avgSmoothIter_eq h₁ 0 i j)
    rw [hzero, abs_zero] at h
    linarith
  · intro hC h hne M hM
    have hzero : avgSmoothIter h 1 i - avgSmoothIter h 1 j = 0 :=
      sub_eq_zero.mpr (avgSmoothIter_eq h 0 i j)
    rw [hzero, abs_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hC (le_of_lt (mean_bound_pos_of_ne hne (hM i) (hM j)))

name: avgSmooth_sharp_witness_two
doc:
**`N = 2` 时的显式归零**：`h = (A, −A)`、均值为 `0`，
则 `avgSmooth h 0 = 0`（**一步精确归零**），从而 `|avgSmooth h 0| = 0`。

**⚠⚠ 命题更正（F8，v16 —— 独立发现；G3 的 round-6 构建日志独立残留同一目标 `⊢ A = 0`，佐证同源。原稿此处为假命题，已改）**：
本定理**原稿**陈述为

    `|avgSmooth h 0 − 0| = (1 − 1/2)·A`

**该命题为假**（`A > 0` 时）：由 `avgSmooth` 的定义
`avgSmooth h i = (1/N)·∑_j h j`（本文件 `:134`）与 `h = (A, −A)` 得

    `avgSmooth h 0 = (1/2)·(A + (−A)) = 0`

故左端 `|0 − 0| = 0`，而右端 `(1 − 1/2)·A = A/2`。**取 `A = 2`（满足 `hA : 0 ≤ 2`）
即得 `0 = 1`，为假**（LEAN 实测残留目标正是 `⊢ A = 0`）。这与文件头 §B 已登记的
「收缩常数是 `1/N`，不是 `1 − 1/N`」**同源**：旧稿把「精确归零」误写成了
`1 − 1/N` 的取等式。**本文件从未也证不出 `1 − 1/N` 的取等**；本节给出的是
**归零见证**，故更正为下面的真命题。

> **⚠ 诚实标注（F8，v16）**：更正后的结论**不再需要** `hA : 0 ≤ A`
> —— 事实上 `avgSmooth h 0 = 0` 对**任意** `A : ℝ` 都成立
> （因为 `(1/2)·(A + (−A)) = 0` 与 `A` 的符号无关）。
> Lean 的 `unused variable` linter **实测报了** `:409:45 unused variable 'hA'`，
> 这正是该事实的机器证据。**保留 `hA` 的原因**：① 不改变公开签名（避免无谓的下游影响）；
> ② 它是原稿「有界特征」语境的见证（`∀j, |h j| ≤ A` 在本节的其他定理中确实使用）。
> ⇒ **若下游要更强的版本，可删 `hA` 得无条件定理**（这是**严格更强**的陈述，无风险）。
> ⚠ 与 `avgSmooth_sharp_witness_fin` 对比：**那条确实需要 `hA`**（它要证 `∀j, |h j| ≤ A`），
> 故 `hA` 在**本节内**并非全局冗余。
stmt:
theorem avgSmooth_sharp_witness_two (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    avgSmooth (fun k : Fin 2 => if k = 0 then A else -A) 0 = 0
proof:
by
                                                                     
                                                              
                                                   
                                                                     
                                                         
                                                  
                                                                             
                                                        
                                   
  have h1 : avgSmooth (fun k : Fin 2 => if k = 0 then A else -A) 0
      = (↑(Fintype.card (Fin 2)) : ℝ)⁻¹
        * ∑ j : Fin 2, (if j = 0 then A else -A) := rfl
                                                                     
  have h2 : (∑ j : Fin 2, (if j = 0 then A else -A))
      = (if (0 : Fin 2) = 0 then A else -A) + (if (1 : Fin 2) = 0 then A else -A) :=
    Fin.sum_univ_two _
                                                                            
  have h3 : (if (0 : Fin 2) = 0 then A else -A) + (if (1 : Fin 2) = 0 then A else -A) = 0 := by
    rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg (by decide : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0), add_neg_cancel]
  rw [h1, h2, h3, Fintype.card_fin, mul_zero]

name: avgSmooth_sharp_ratio_two
doc:
**`N = 2` 的收缩比值形式（更正后）**：对 `h = (A, −A)`，
`|avgSmooth h 0| = 0`（比值是 `0`，**不是** `1/2`）。

**⚠⚠ 命题更正（F8，v16 —— 独立发现；G3 的 round-6 构建日志独立残留同一目标 `⊢ A = 0`，佐证同源）**：原稿陈述为
`|avgSmooth h 0| = (1 − 1/2)·|h 0|`，**该命题为假**（`A > 0` 时：
左端 `= 0`，而右端 `= (1/2)·|A| = A/2`；取 `A = 2` 得 `0 = 1`）。
**根因同上**：`h = (A, −A)` 在 `N = 2` 上被**精确归零**，故任何「收缩到 `(1/2)·A`」
的说法都与之矛盾。**已更正为真命题**：左端恒为 `0`。
stmt:
theorem avgSmooth_sharp_ratio_two (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    |avgSmooth (fun k : Fin 2 => if k = 0 then A else -A) 0| = 0
proof:
by
  rw [avgSmooth_sharp_witness_two A hA, abs_zero]

name: avgSmooth_sharp_witness_fin
doc:
**一般 `N` 的显式归零见证**：在 `N ≥ 2` 个节点上取

    `h := (A, −A/(N−1), …, −A/(N−1))`（一个 `+A`、`N−1` 个 `−A/(N−1)`），

则均值为 `0`、`∀j, |h j| ≤ A`，且 `avgSmooth h 0 = 0`（`i = 0`）。

**⚠ 意义校准（Z1-2，v14）**：本定理结论是 `avgSmooth h i = 0` —— **精确归零**，
**不是** `= (1 − 1/N)·A`（旧稿 docstring 曾这么写，**错误**：由
`avgSmooth h 0 = (1/N)(A − (N−1)·A/(N−1)) = (1/N)·0 = 0` 可知左端是 `0`，
而 `(1 − 1/N)·A` 在 `A > 0`、`N ≥ 3` 时 **非零**，两者不可能相等）。
它的价值是给出一个**显式的、可内核验证的归零点**，说明「一次投影即归零」；
**未做**：把 `1/N`（或旧稿的 `1 − 1/N`）写成一般图上的最优收缩常数
（需要谱间隙/混合时间，见文件头诚实边界）。
stmt:
theorem avgSmooth_sharp_witness_fin (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    ∃ (h : Fin N → ℝ) (i : Fin N),
        (∀ j, |h j| ≤ A)
      ∧ (∑ j, h j = 0)
      ∧ (avgSmooth h i = 0)

name: avgSmooth_shrink_factor_eq
doc:
**代数换算恒等式**：对任意 `N ≥ 1`，`(1 − 1/N) = ((N−1)/N)`（证明正确，保留）。

**⚠ 用途标注（Z1-2，v14）**：这是**纯代数换算**，**不**声称 `1 − 1/N` 是本文件的
收缩常数——本文件实际证明的收缩常数是 `1/N`（见 `avgSmooth_deviation_shrink`
与文件头 §B 校准）。保留本定理仅因它是真的恒等式、且便于将来把任一常数
写成两种形式。
stmt:
theorem avgSmooth_shrink_factor_eq (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (1 - (N : ℝ)⁻¹) = ((N : ℝ) - 1) / (N : ℝ)

by
  have hNR : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    have : 0 < N := hN
    exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt this

    rw [h3, inv_mul_cancel₀ hNR]
  exact (eq_div_iff hNR).mpr h2

name: na_norm_sub_le_max
doc: 强三角（减法形式）：`‖x − y‖ ≤ max ‖x‖ ‖y‖`。
stmt: lemma na_norm_sub_le_max (x y : K) : ‖x - y‖ ≤ max ‖x‖ ‖y‖
proof:
by
  have h := IsNonarchimedeanNorm.norm_add_le_max x (-y)
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, norm_neg] using h

name: na_norm_add_eq_max_of_lt
doc:
**强三角的等号情形（`‖x‖ < ‖y‖`）**：`‖x + y‖ = max ‖x‖ ‖y‖`。
核心论证：`‖y‖ = ‖(x+y) − x‖ ≤ max ‖x+y‖ ‖x‖`；若 `‖x+y‖ < ‖y‖` 则右边 `max < ‖y‖`，
矛盾，故 `‖y‖ ≤ ‖x+y‖`；结合强三角得等号。
stmt:
lemma na_norm_add_eq_max_of_lt {x y : K} (hlt : ‖x‖ < ‖y‖) :
    ‖x + y‖ = max ‖x‖ ‖y‖
proof:
by
  have hbound : ‖y‖ ≤ max ‖x + y‖ ‖x‖ := by
    calc ‖y‖ = ‖(x + y) - x‖ := by rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
      _ ≤ max ‖x + y‖ ‖x‖ := na_norm_sub_le_max _ _
  have hxy : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x + y‖ := by
    by_contra hc
    rw [not_le] at hc
    have hmax : max ‖x + y‖ ‖x‖ < ‖y‖ := max_lt hc hlt
    linarith
  have hle : ‖x + y‖ ≤ max ‖x‖ ‖y‖ := IsNonarchimedeanNorm.norm_add_le_max x y
  rw [max_eq_right (le_of_lt hlt)] at hle ⊢
  exact le_antisymm hle hxy

name: na_norm_add_eq_max_of_ne
doc: **强三角的等号情形**：`‖x‖ ≠ ‖y‖ ⟹ ‖x + y‖ = max ‖x‖ ‖y‖`。
stmt:
theorem na_norm_add_eq_max_of_ne {x y : K} (h : ‖x‖ ≠ ‖y‖) :
    ‖x + y‖ = max ‖x‖ ‖y‖
proof:
by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with hlt | hgt
  · exact na_norm_add_eq_max_of_lt hlt
  · rw [add_comm, max_comm]
    exact na_norm_add_eq_max_of_lt hgt

name: na_norm_sub_eq_max_of_ne
doc: **等边三角形性质**：`‖x‖ ≠ ‖y‖ ⟹ ‖x − y‖ = max ‖x‖ ‖y‖`。
stmt:
theorem na_norm_sub_eq_max_of_ne {x y : K} (h : ‖x‖ ≠ ‖y‖) :
    ‖x - y‖ = max ‖x‖ ‖y‖
proof:
by
  have h' : ‖x‖ ≠ ‖-y‖ := by simpa [norm_neg] using h
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using na_norm_add_eq_max_of_ne h'

name: na_norm_finset_sum_le
doc: **有限和的强三角界（非严格）**：`0 ≤ C` 且 `∀ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ≤ C` ⟹ `‖∑_{i∈s} f i‖ ≤ C`。
stmt:
lemma na_norm_finset_sum_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → K) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ≤ C) : ‖∑ i in s, f i‖ ≤ C
proof:
by
  classical
  revert h
  refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
  · intro _
    rw [Finset.sum_empty, norm_zero]
    exact hC
  · intro a s ha ih h
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
    have h1 : ‖f a‖ ≤ C := h a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
    have h2 : ‖∑ i in s, f i‖ ≤ C :=
      ih (fun i hi => h i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
    exact le_trans (IsNonarchimedeanNorm.norm_add_le_max _ _) (max_le h1 h2)

name: na_norm_finset_sum_lt
doc: **有限和的强三角界（严格）**：`0 < C` 且 `∀ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ < C` ⟹ `‖∑_{i∈s} f i‖ < C`。
stmt:
lemma na_norm_finset_sum_lt {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → K) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ < C) : ‖∑ i in s, f i‖ < C
proof:
by
  classical
  revert h
  refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
  · intro _
    rw [Finset.sum_empty, norm_zero]
    exact hC
  · intro a s ha ih h
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
    have h1 : ‖f a‖ < C := h a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
    have h2 : ‖∑ i in s, f i‖ < C :=
      ih (fun i hi => h i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (IsNonarchimedeanNorm.norm_add_le_max _ _) (max_lt h1 h2)

name: na_norm_finset_sum_le_sup
doc: **有限和的 max 形式**：非空 `s` 上 `‖∑_{i∈s} f i‖ ≤ s.sup' hs (‖f ·‖)`。
stmt:
lemma na_norm_finset_sum_le_sup {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (f : ι → K) :
    ‖∑ i in s, f i‖ ≤ s.sup' hs (fun i => ‖f i‖)
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hs
  exact na_norm_finset_sum_le s f _
    (le_trans (norm_nonneg (f i)) (Finset.le_sup' (fun i => ‖f i‖) hi))
    (fun j hj => Finset.le_sup' (fun i => ‖f i‖) hj)

name: na_isClosed_ball
doc:
**开球是闭集**：在非阿基米德范数下，`Metric.ball x r` 的补集是开集。
证明：若 `y ∉ ball x r` 且 `y ≠ x`，取 `ε = ‖y − x‖ > 0`；对 `ball y ε` 中任意 `z`
有 `‖z − y‖ < ‖y − x‖`，由 `na_norm_add_eq_max_of_lt` 得
`‖z − x‖ = ‖(z−y) + (y−x)‖ = ‖y − x‖ ≥ r`，故 `z ∉ ball x r`。
stmt: theorem na_isClosed_ball (x : K) (r : ℝ) : IsClosed (Metric.ball x r)
proof:
by
  rw [← isOpen_compl_iff, Metric.isOpen_iff]
  intro y hy
  simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Metric.mem_ball, not_lt, dist_eq_norm] at hy
  by_cases hyx : y = x
  ·                                             
    subst hyx
    have hy0 : r ≤ 0 := by simpa using hy
    refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩
    intro z hz hzx
    simp only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hzx
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖z - y‖ := norm_nonneg _
    linarith
  · refine ⟨‖y - x‖, norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hyx), ?_⟩
    intro z hz hzx
    simp only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz hzx
    have hkey : z - x = (z - y) + (y - x) := by ring
    rw [hkey, na_norm_add_eq_max_of_lt hz, max_eq_right (le_of_lt hz)] at hzx
    linarith

name: na_ball_isClopen
doc: **开球既开又闭（clopen）**：`Metric.ball x r` 的 `IsClopen`。
stmt: theorem na_ball_isClopen (x : K) (r : ℝ) : IsClopen (Metric.ball x r)
proof: ⟨na_isClosed_ball x r, Metric.isOpen_ball⟩

name: na_tail_sum_norm_lt
doc:
**尾和范数 → 0**：`‖aₙ‖ → 0` ⟹ 任意尾部有限和 `∑_{m≤i<m+k} aᵢ` 的范数 → 0。
这是非阿基米德级数「项 → 0 ⟹ 收敛」的 Cauchy 内核（尾和即部分和之差：
`∑_{i<m+k} aᵢ − ∑_{i<m} aᵢ = ∑_{m≤i<m+k} aᵢ`，见 `Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub`）。
stmt:
theorem na_tail_sum_norm_lt (a : ℕ → K)
    (h : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖a n‖) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ eps : ℝ, 0 < eps → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ k : ℕ,
      ‖∑ i in Finset.Ico m (m + k), a i‖ < eps
proof:
by
  intro eps heps
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, ‖a n‖ < eps := by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h) eps heps
    exact ⟨N, fun n hn => by
      have := hN n hn
      simpa [dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg (a n))] using this⟩
  refine ⟨N, fun m hm k => ?_⟩
  refine na_norm_finset_sum_lt _ _ eps heps ?_
  intro i hi
  exact hN i (le_trans hm (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).1)

omit [IsNonarchimedeanNorm K] in

name: na_sum_range_sub_eq_Ico
stmt:
lemma na_sum_range_sub_eq_Ico (a : ℕ → K) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    (∑ i in Finset.range n, a i) - (∑ i in Finset.range m, a i)
      = ∑ i in Finset.Ico m n, a i
proof: (Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub a hmn).symm

name: na_converges_of_tendsto_zero
doc:
**非阿基米德级数收敛（显式完备性假设）**：`[CompleteSpace K]` 下，
`‖aₙ‖ → 0` ⟹ 部分和 `n ↦ ∑_{i<n} aᵢ` 收敛。

证明：由 `na_tail_sum_norm_lt` 与 `na_sum_range_sub_eq_Ico`（尾和 = 部分和之差）得部分和是
Cauchy 序列，再用 `cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete` 得到极限。

诚实标注：**完备性作为显式假设** `[CompleteSpace K]`；
**mathlib 4.14 的 `ℚ_[p]` 满足它**（`PadicNumbers.lean:921`），但本文件不做接线。
stmt:
theorem na_converges_of_tendsto_zero [CompleteSpace K] (a : ℕ → K)
    (h : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖a n‖) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∃ L : K, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i in Finset.range n, a i) Filter.atTop (𝓝 L)
proof:
by
  refine cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete ?_
  rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
  intro eps heps
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := na_tail_sum_norm_lt a h eps heps
  refine ⟨N, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
  rcases le_total m n with hmn | hnm
  · simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev, ← na_sum_range_sub_eq_Ico a hmn,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel' hmn] using hN m hm (n - m)
  · simpa [dist_eq_norm, ← na_sum_range_sub_eq_Ico a hnm,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel' hnm] using hN n hn (m - n)

name: na_of_isUltrametricDist
doc:
**由 `IsUltrametricDist` 得到 `IsNonarchimedeanNorm`**（范数层面的强三角不等式）。

证明：`dist x z ≤ max (dist x y) (dist y z)` 是 `IsUltrametricDist` 的定义；
取 `x = 0`、`y = -a`、`z = b - a`（即 `0 → -a → b - a`，距离分别是 `‖a‖` 与 `‖b‖`），
用 `dist_eq_norm` 把距离化为范数即得 `‖b‖ ≤ max ‖a‖ ‖b‖`；
对称地取路径 `0 → -b → a - b` 得 `‖a‖ ≤ max ‖a‖ ‖b‖`，两者合并给出
`‖a + b‖ ≤ max ‖a‖ ‖b‖`（再用 `a + b = (a+b) - 0` 与 `dist_eq_norm`）。

诚实标注：本定理**不需要** `K` 是域，`NormedRing`/`NormedAddCommGroup` 即可；
此处为与本文件的 `NormedField K` 语境一致而限定。
stmt:
theorem na_of_isUltrametricDist (K : Type*) [NormedField K] [IsUltrametricDist K] :
    IsNonarchimedeanNorm K where
  norm_add_le_max
proof:
fun x y => by
                                                                    
    have h1 : dist (-y) x ≤ max (dist (-y) (0 : K)) (dist (0 : K) x) :=
      IsUltrametricDist.dist_triangle_max (-y) 0 x
                                          
    have h2 : dist (-y) x = ‖x + y‖ := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_add_rev, norm_neg, add_comm]
    have h3 : dist (-y) (0 : K) = ‖y‖ := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, sub_zero, norm_neg]
    have h4 : dist (0 : K) x = ‖x‖ := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, zero_sub, norm_neg]
    rw [h2, h3, h4, max_comm] at h1
    exact h1

end Lattice

name: rms_pos_of_nonzero
stmt: theorem rms_pos_of_nonzero (x : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) (h : x i ≠ 0) : 0 < rms x
proof:
by
  unfold rms
                               
  have hsq : 0 < (x i) ^ 2 := by
    have hn : (x i) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      exact h (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hz)
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg (x i)) (Ne.symm hn)
  have hS : 0 < ∑ j, x j ^ 2 := by
              
    have hle : (x i) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, x j ^ 2 := by
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun j => x j ^ 2) (a := i)
        (fun j hj => sq_nonneg (x j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hsq hle
                                
  have hnpos : 0 < (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨i⟩)
  have hc : 0 < (∑ j, x j ^ 2) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := div_pos hS hnpos
  exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hc

end Lattice

name: rmsNormGeneral_lipschitz
doc:
**`rmsNormGeneral_lipschitz`（核心推广）**：一般实内积空间上，`rmsNormGeneral a` 在
    范数下界 `‖x‖, ‖y‖ ≥ c > 0` 上是 **(a/c)-Lipschitz**。

    这是 `RealRMSNormSharpness.rmsNormE_sqrt_lipschitz` 的**推广**：
    后者要求类型恰为 `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)` 且尺度恰为 `√n`
    （`√n` 被 `rmsNormE` 的定义体写死），本定理把两者都放开 ——
    **类型**换成任意实内积空间 `E`，**尺度**换成任意 `a ≥ 0`。

    ⚠ `ha : 0 ≤ a` 不可省：`a < 0` 时右端为负而左端非负，结论在 `x ≠ y` 时**假**。
    ⚠ `a = 0` 包含在内（此时映射常值 `0`，界为 `0 ≤ 0`）。
    ⚠ 退化空间 `E = {0}` 上本定理**真空真**（`0 < c ≤ ‖x‖` 不可满足）。
stmt:
theorem rmsNormGeneral_lipschitz {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (x y : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hy : c ≤ ‖y‖) :
    ‖rmsNormGeneral a x - rmsNormGeneral a y‖ ≤ (a / c) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  have hdiff : rmsNormGeneral a x - rmsNormGeneral a y
      = a • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y) := by
    unfold rmsNormGeneral
    rw [← smul_sub]
  rw [hdiff, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ha]
  calc
    a * ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ ≤ a * ((1 / c) * ‖x - y‖) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (unit_normalize_lipschitz_sharp x y c hc hx hy) ha
    _ = (a / c) * ‖x - y‖ := by ring

lemma norm_rmsNormGeneral {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

name: rmsNormGeneral_antipodal_norm
doc:
对径点对的像距：`‖rmsNormGeneral a x − rmsNormGeneral a (−x)‖ = 2a`
    （`‖x‖ = c`，`a ≥ 0`）。
stmt:
lemma rmsNormGeneral_antipodal_norm {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (x : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ‖x‖ = c) :
    ‖rmsNormGeneral a x - rmsNormGeneral a (-x)‖ = 2 * a
proof:
by
  rw [rmsNormGeneral_neg]
  have hsub : rmsNormGeneral a x - -rmsNormGeneral a x = (2 : ℝ) • rmsNormGeneral a x := by
    rw [sub_neg_eq_add, two_smul]
  rw [hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_rmsNormGeneral a ha x c hc hx]
  norm_num

name: norm_sub_neg_general
doc:
`‖x‖ = c` 时 `‖x − (−x)‖ = 2c`（一般内积空间版；原专用版见 `norm_sub_neg`）。
    ⚠ 需要 `[InnerProductSpace ℝ E]`（比 `[NormedAddCommGroup E]` 强）：
    证明用 `(2 : ℝ) • x`，在纯赋范群上没有 `ℝ`-模结构。
stmt:
lemma norm_sub_neg_general {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (x : E) (c : ℝ) (hx : ‖x‖ = c) :
    ‖x - (-x)‖ = 2 * c
proof:
by
  have hsub : x - (-x) = (2 : ℝ) • x := by rw [sub_neg_eq_add, two_smul]
  rw [hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hx]

name: rmsNormGeneral_sharp_attained
doc:
**`rmsNormGeneral_sharp_attained`（取等）**：一般实内积空间中，任何范数为 `c` 的 `x`
    与它的对径点 `−x` **精确达到**常数 `a/c`：
    `‖F x − F(−x)‖ = (a/c)·‖x − (−x)‖`（`a ≥ 0`、`0 < c`、`‖x‖ = c`）。

    这是 `RealRMSNormSharpness.rmsNormE_sharp_attained` 的推广。
stmt:
theorem rmsNormGeneral_sharp_attained {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (x : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ‖x‖ = c) :
    ‖rmsNormGeneral a x - rmsNormGeneral a (-x)‖ = (a / c) * ‖x - (-x)‖
proof:
by
  rw [rmsNormGeneral_antipodal_norm a ha x c hc hx, norm_sub_neg_general x c hx]
  have hval : (a / c) * (2 * c) = 2 * a := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hval]

name: exists_norm_eq_general
doc:
**存在范数为 `c` 的向量**（`n > 0` 的 `Fin n` 情形；见 `RealRMSNormSharpness.exists_norm_eq`）。
    ⚠ 名字写**裸名** `exists_norm_eq`：本文件与 `RealRMSNormSharpness` 同在 `Lattice` 命名空间，
    而 `RealRMSNormSharpness` 是**模块名不是命名空间** ⟹ 限定形式 `RealRMSNormSharpness.exists_norm_eq`
    **不在作用域**（实测报 `unknown identifier`）。
stmt:
lemma exists_norm_eq_general {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖x‖ = c
proof: exists_norm_eq hn c hc

name: rmsNormGeneral_sharp_pair_exists
doc:
**取等点对存在**：任意实内积空间中只要**有非零向量**，对每个 `c > 0` 就存在范数为 `c`
    的 `x`，使其与 `−x` 精确达到 `a/c`（`a ≥ 0`）。
    ⚠ 前提 `∃ z, z ≠ 0` 是**本质的**：零空间里不存在范数为 `c > 0` 的向量。
stmt:
theorem rmsNormGeneral_sharp_pair_exists {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (hne : ∃ z : E, z ≠ 0) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ x : E, ‖x‖ = c ∧
      ‖rmsNormGeneral a x - rmsNormGeneral a (-x)‖ = (a / c) * ‖x - (-x)‖
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hne
  have hzpos : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz
  refine ⟨(c / ‖z‖) • z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg (le_of_lt hc) (norm_nonneg _))]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ c (ne_of_gt hzpos)
  · exact rmsNormGeneral_sharp_attained a ha _ c hc (by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg (le_of_lt hc) (norm_nonneg _))]
      exact div_mul_cancel₀ c (ne_of_gt hzpos))

name: rmsNormGeneral_constant_lower_bound
doc:
**`rmsNormGeneral_constant_lower_bound`**：取等点对给出任意有效 Lipschitz 常数的下界
    `K ≥ a/c`（`a ≥ 0`，`‖x‖ = c`，且 `K` 对**所有** `y` 成立）。
    与 `rmsNormGeneral_lipschitz` 合起来说明 `a/c` 是**真正常数**。
stmt:
theorem rmsNormGeneral_constant_lower_bound {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (x : E) (c K : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ‖x‖ = c)
    (hK : ∀ y : E, ‖rmsNormGeneral a x - rmsNormGeneral a y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖) :
    a / c ≤ K
proof:
by
  have h := hK (-x)
  have h2 : ‖x - (-x)‖ = 2 * c := norm_sub_neg_general x c hx
  rw [rmsNormGeneral_antipodal_norm a ha x c hc hx, h2] at h
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hc]
  nlinarith [h]

name: rmsNormGeneral_two_div_not_attained
doc:
**`rmsNormGeneral_two_div_not_attained`**：`a > 0` 时保守界 `(2a/c)` 在取等点对上
    **严格**（`2a < 4a`），故 `2a/c` 不是紧界 —— 真常数 `≤ a/c`。
    （原库对应结论：`RealNormSharpConstant.rmsNorm_two_sqrt_not_attained`。）
stmt:
theorem rmsNormGeneral_two_div_not_attained {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (x : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ‖x‖ = c) :
    ‖rmsNormGeneral a x - rmsNormGeneral a (-x)‖ < (2 * a / c) * ‖x - (-x)‖
proof:
by
  rw [rmsNormGeneral_antipodal_norm a (le_of_lt ha) x c hc hx, norm_sub_neg_general x c hx]
  have hval : (2 * a / c) * (2 * c) = 4 * a := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hval]
  linarith

name: rmsNormE_eq_rmsNormGeneral
doc:
**`rmsNormE_eq_rmsNormGeneral`（定义层回收，逐点）**：在 `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)` 上、
    取 `a = √n`，推广定义**逐字**退化为既有的 `RealNormSharpConstant.rmsNormE`。
    **`rfl` 可证**（两侧定义体在 `a := √n`、`E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)` 下是同一项）——
    ⚠ 这是"新定理严格强于原定理"的**机器可查证据**，而非文字论证。
stmt:
theorem rmsNormE_eq_rmsNormGeneral {n : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    rmsNormE x = rmsNormGeneral (Real.sqrt n) x
proof: rfl

name: rmsNormGeneral_sqrt_eq_rmsNormE
doc:
**`rmsNormGeneral_sqrt_eq_rmsNormE`（函数层回收）**：上一条的 `funext` 形式。
    ⚠ **不是 `rfl`**：`rmsNormE` 的 `n` 是**隐式**参数（写成 `rmsNormE x`），
    而 `rmsNormGeneral (Real.sqrt n)` 需显式给出 `E`，两者的**隐式参数结构不同**
    ⟹ 命题是"两个函数外延相等"，需 `funext` 而不能靠 defeq 直接闭合。
    （这一点**经探针实测**：`Real.sqrt n` 在 `n : ℕ` 处**无需 `↑n` 转换**即可精化，
    真因是隐式参数的 eta 结构，不是类型转换。）
stmt:
theorem rmsNormGeneral_sqrt_eq_rmsNormE (n : ℕ) :
    rmsNormGeneral (E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (Real.sqrt n) = rmsNormE (n := n)
proof: funext fun x => (rmsNormE_eq_rmsNormGeneral x).symm
